title: Arabic investigation-app watch: iTunes Lookup API re-check of 16 tracked apps in SA, EG and AE storefronts (2026-10-27)
title_ar: رصد تطبيقات التحقيق العربية: إعادة فحص 16 تطبيقاً عبر واجهة iTunes Lookup
authors: ATHAR W2-MEDIA-COMP team (data capture via Apple iTunes Lookup API)
key_findings: invsroom: v2.1 updated 26 Oct 2026, 4 ratings (SA), 0 in EG/AE; release notes add two Arabic-interface cases including a 9-suspect murder of a young mother found beside her small daughter.
BUSTED: v1.0.9 updated 26 Oct 2026, 2 ratings (SA); now pitches 'a new case file every six hours' with a free weekly case, ads, and Firebase analytics without personal identifiers.
Al-Qadiya 001: 8 ratings, 4.6 (SA); Tuhma 2; Ultra Murdle 3; Al-Mufattish Fahlawy 0 (SA) / 2 (EG); i.e., none of the 2026 Arabic wave passed 10 ratings in any of the three storefronts.
Wave-1 benchmarks unchanged: Lughz al-Jarima 676 ratings (SA, last updated 2021); Tamatem's Girls' Secrets 9,991 (SA); HUMAIN Chat 1,968 (SA).
athar_applications: Baseline for the monthly watchlist (COMPETITOR_WATCHLIST_2026-10.md): threshold alert when any tracked Arabic app passes 100 ratings in SA or adds a school/teacher mode.
Confirms that, three to fifteen weeks after launch, the Arabic AI-interrogation wave has not found traction on iOS.
limitations: Rating counts are a weak, lagging proxy for installs; Android not covered by this record (see ATH-SRC-2060).
Snapshot of one day; per-storefront counts.

title: Google Play listing re-check (gl=SA): install bands of Arabic and AI detective apps, 2026-10-27
title_ar: فحص صفحات Google Play: فئات التنزيل لتطبيقات التحقيق العربية والذكية
key_findings: Wave-1 Arabic titles: دائرة الشك 1K+ (updated 2 Aug 2026); ملف القضية 500+ (updated 24 Aug 2026); CrimeBot 1M+ / 4.57 / 17.3K reviews (last update 26 Nov 2025); CrimeBot 2 100K+.

None of the 2026 Arabic AI-interrogation apps (invsroom, BUSTED, Al-Mufattish Fahlawy, Al-Qadiya 001, Tuhma) was returned by Google Play search for its own name; they appear to be iOS-only (absence, not proof).

Global AI-interrogation Android titles: Case Mind 10K+ (Arabic among 10 languages), Detective AI: Mystery Game 10K+, Chat of Deduction 5K+, Interrogation Room: Detective 500+ (Arabic among 7 languages); several others 100+.
Search 'محقق ذكاء اصطناعي' on Play SA surfaces generic chatbots and Chat of Deduction, not Arabic-made games.
athar_applications: Closes G25 item 'Google Play installs of Arabic AI-interrogation apps': there are none visible on Play; Egypt/Morocco Android majority is therefore unserved by the 2026 Arabic wave.
Android-first launch for Egypt and Morocco is a white space; iOS-first for the Gulf.
limitations: Install bands are global lifetime and coarse; Play search ranking is personalised and may hide small apps.
Package names for iOS-only apps could exist under different names.

title: Case Mind: AI Murder Mystery — Google Play listing
title_ar: Case Mind: لغز جريمة بالذكاء الاصطناعي
key_findings: 10K+ downloads; rated 16 (PEGI-style label on SA page); updated 22 Oct 2026; available in 10 languages including Arabic (listing text).
Design statement: AI suspects answer typed questions, but every culprit, timeline, clue and solution is authored in advance; 'the case engine protects what really happened'.
Accusation requires culprit, method, motive and proof; four endings per case depending on what was proved; premium buys unlimited hints and early access, cases remain free to play.
athar_applications: Independent confirmation that authored truth plus LLM voices (ATHAR's architecture) is now the industry pattern; differentiation must come from teen safety, pedagogy and Arabic quality, not the engine.
Endings that depend on what was proved are a strong mechanic for rewarding evidence quality rather than just naming the culprit; ATHAR's scoring can map to similar outcome tiers.
limitations: Developer identity and country not verified (support e-mail domain differs from developer name).
Arabic quality not tested; murder themes (16).

title: Interrogation Room: Detective (Serthan Topal) — Google Play listing
key_findings: Play: 500+ downloads, rated 16, updated 26 Oct 2026; 'Play in seven languages' including Arabic; offline, no account.
Noir murder cases with four suspects, notebook contradictions, one accusation per case, sequential unlocking.
Same developer publishes several 2026 iOS detective apps with Arabic metadata (Interrogation Room: Murder; Cold Crime: Phone Detective; Forgotten Mystery), each with 0–3 SA ratings in the snapshot.
athar_applications: Example of a solo developer shipping multiple Arabic-localised detective apps per quarter: low barrier means ATHAR cannot win on 'Arabic detective game' alone.
limitations: Minimal traction; included to evidence volume of low-cost entrants.

title: Detective AI: Mystery Game (STaR) — Google Play listing
key_findings: 10K+ downloads; rated 12+; updated 8 Oct 2026; Google sign-in required.

Authored case records are in English and playable offline; AI features (AI-generated mysteries, AI advice, online hints, 'Case Crew') share a daily request allowance; premium subscription raises limits; hints via rewarded ads for free players.
athar_applications: Shows the cost-control pattern AI games use (daily AI quota, rewarded-ad hints): ATHAR must budget per-session LLM cost (G28) and avoid ad-gated hints for minors.
limitations: No Arabic; global competitor for attention only.

title: Chat of Deduction: Consultant (Bedrock, inc.) — Google Play listing
key_findings: 5K+ downloads; rated 3+; updated 6 Sep 2026; Korean developer (package kr.co.bedrock).
Turn-based free-form interrogation without dialogue trees; reasoning 'corners the culprit' via contradictions (moved alibi, confident wrong answer).
athar_applications: Turn-limited interrogation is a cost and pacing control ATHAR can adopt (limited questions per suspect forces hypothesis-driven questioning, assessable as a skill).
limitations: No Arabic in description; surfaced by Arabic search on Play SA.

title: ColdTrace: Cold Case Mystery (Saclic Studio) — App Store listing (SA)
key_findings: Released 31 May 2026; v1.3.0 (24 Oct 2026); 9+; Arabic among 13 languages.
Ratings 2026-10-27: SA 4.6 from 71; EG 4.7 from 85; AE 4.7 from 119; US 4.8 from 6,263; in the six-store snapshot it is the most-rated 2026 detective launch with Arabic support.
Player explores a simulated phone (messages, photos, notes, voicemails) to decide whether a death was an accident; some chapters require Premium (SA in-app prices seen from SAR 29.99 to 129.99).
athar_applications: The 'investigate a phone' format reaches more Arab players than any Arabic-made 2026 title: ATHAR's digital-evidence cases (source verification, timestamps) should use a phone-like UI.
A 9+ rating with a death premise is achievable when nothing is depicted: useful precedent for ATHAR's 13–15 framing.
limitations: Rating counts lag installs; Arabic translation quality not tested.
Price list read from store page markup; individual IAP names not mapped.

title: Inquest — Daily Detective Game (Rizk Corsight, LLC) — App Store listing (SA)
key_findings: Released 26 Jun 2026; 9+; Arabic among about 30 listing languages; 0 ratings in SA/EG/AE/US (2026-10-27).
One shared case per day; 736 mysteries 'validated by a built-in fair-play solver'; players name culprit, weapon, place and motive and stake a confidence level that moves their rank.
Four twist types (false alibi, mistaken identity, accomplice cover, wrong weapon); five ranks from Constable to 'Sherlock'.
athar_applications: Two ATHAR-core ideas already in a consumer app: automated fair-play validation and confidence wagering (calibration). ATHAR must therefore claim not the mechanics but their *validated* measurement for learning (KO-LA calibration).
Daily shared case = social comparison loop worth testing.
limitations: No traction yet; claims not tested.

title: فاكس: بكّاس وجريمة قتل (Fax: Bakkas wa Jarimat Qatl) — App Store listing (SA)
key_findings: Released 21 Oct 2026; 12+; Arabic only; free; one phone passed around 3–12 players, offline.

Murder mode: 100 cases written in Egyptian dialect (villa, Sahel chalet, sleeper train, wedding, Sharm hotel...); each player gets a role with whereabouts and a secret; evidence revealed step by step with eliminations; full solution 'with all the loopholes' at the end; easy/medium/hard levels.
Also includes an 'impostor word' mode with Egyptian categories plus a Gulf category.
athar_applications: Newest entrant (6 days old) confirms the 2026 Arabic wave now includes Egyptian-dialect, offline, group play: ATHAR's group/classroom mode should support single-device pass-and-play and offline.
End-of-game full solution 'with loopholes' mirrors ATHAR's post-case debrief.
limitations: 1 rating (EG) at capture; no traction data.

title: وش السالفة؟ - تحقيق مع الجاسوس (Wesh al-Salfa) — App Store listing (SA)
key_findings: Released 19 May 2025; v1.8 (9 Jul 2026); rated 17+; ratings: SA 3.9 from 30, EG 4.4 from 9.
Spy/impostor social deduction in Gulf dialect: everyone knows the topic except the spy; questioning then voting; online rooms, friends list and in-game chat; weekend 'Salfat al-Majlis' mode.
athar_applications: The best-rated Arabic-titled 'تحقيق' app in the snapshot is a social deduction party game, not a case game: Gulf demand for investigation-as-social-play is real; ATHAR's group mode should be fast and conversational.
Its 17+ rating (open chat with strangers) shows why ATHAR must avoid open stranger chat for minors.
limitations: Small rating base.

title: Detective Dana (Vice Beast) — Steam store page
key_findings: Released 6 Jan 2026; free to play; Arabic-only with full Arabic audio; '3 user reviews' (insufficient for a score) on 2026-10-27.

2D story game: an Arabic (Saudi-set, per the official site) female police officer investigates murders; find contradictions in witness statements and present contrary evidence; 3 episodes, about 6 hours; 100-page script equivalent; 50 min of original music.
Official site mentions TikTok sponsorship and an Arab Game Awards vote (2023), suggesting a long development cycle.
athar_applications: Arabic voiced detective adventure with a female Saudi lead exists and is free, yet has almost no Steam reviews: narrative quality alone does not create reach; distribution is the bottleneck.
Contradiction-and-present-evidence mechanic (Ace Attorney) in Arabic is now precedent; ATHAR cannot claim novelty for it.
limitations: Install counts not public on Steam; review count very low.
Steam lists no content descriptors; murder themes.

title: Homicide Desk — Steam news feed and store re-check (post-launch updates, 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-01)
title_ar: Homicide Desk — تحديثات ما بعد الإطلاق
key_findings: Developer posts: '1,000 players' milestone on launch day (1 Sep 2026); Steam Deck Verified (3 Sep); two free new cases on 6 Sep (difficulty 3 and difficulty 5 'Chief'); 35% Autumn Sale discount announced 1 Oct.
Patch notes show the game bundles a local model server (ollama / llama-server) and was fully translated into all ten languages in v1.3.8.

Store re-check (2026-10-27): SAR 15.99; still 'Mixed', 67% of 94 reviews; Steam content note confirms homicide reports with injury descriptions and an optional blackjack minigame with in-game currency; Indonesia IGRS rating 18, Germany USK 16, Brazil DEJUS 12.
athar_applications: No measurable growth in reviews in the eight weeks after launch: the closest functional competitor is not scaling quickly; threat level stays 'high-similarity, low-reach'.
On-device LLM via bundled local server is feasible on PC but heavy; ATHAR's mobile target needs a different (server or small-model) approach (team 10).
Shu'la Lab funding/team remains unknown (G25 item open).
limitations: Player count is a developer claim; reviews are a lagging proxy.
Studio site is client-rendered and returned no text; funding not found in search.

title: Which languages can I use for Khanmigo and free teacher tools? (Khan Academy Help Center)
title_ar: ما اللغات المتاحة في خانميغو وأدوات المعلم المجانية؟
key_findings: Updated 22 Oct 2026: Khanmigo and the free teacher tools list Arabic among about 40 supported languages.
Only English, Hindi, Spanish and Portuguese are fully quality-tested; other languages (including Arabic) may show translation or formatting issues and are flagged in settings.
Companion article (updated 14 Sep 2026): Arabic works as Khanmigo's response language but not as the Khan Academy site language; text-to-speech only in 4 languages; speech-to-text English only.
athar_applications: Resolves G25 'Khanmigo languages': Arabic exists but is experimental and text-only; ATHAR's Arabic voice and MSA quality remain differentiators for now.
Khanmigo's free teacher tools in Arabic could reach Arab teachers; ATHAR's teacher kit should interoperate rather than compete (e.g., exportable lesson plans).
limitations: Help-centre statements, not quality evaluations; country availability of paid tiers is restricted (US for learners).

title: Hidden Door — official site and pricing page (2026 re-check)
key_findings: Pricing page (2026-10-27): play across the whole catalogue is free and unlimited; paid 'Creator' tier to make, share and monetise worlds; partner programme with payouts.

Homepage lists official worlds including 'Sherlock Holmes: The Blue Carbuncle', Dracula, The Land of Oz and The Call of Cthulhu, with world rating tags all_ages / teen / mature, and an 'instant world' prompt example of a Victorian detective city.
Site is served with lang='en'; no Arabic or other UI language and no language selector were found.
athar_applications: Resolves G25 'Hidden Door languages': English-only as observed; threat to ATHAR in Arabic remains indirect.
Free unlimited play shifts the AI-story market to creator monetisation: ATHAR should not plan consumer revenue on AI chat time.
limitations: Language support inferred from site markup; in-app language handling not tested.
No user numbers published.

title: PraxiLabs blog posts (Aug–Oct 2026) and LTI configuration guide — product capability re-check
title_ar: PraxiLabs — إعادة فحص القدرات (العربية، التكامل مع أنظمة التعلم، المساعد الذكي)
key_findings: Blog (26 Oct 2026, via the site's WordPress API): 210+ simulations across 20+ science branches; AI lab assistant 'Oxi'; 'bilingual access in Arabic and English'; LMS integration with Moodle and Canvas.
Blog (20 Aug 2026): LMS integration with Moodle, Canvas or Blackboard claimed to take one day; 24/7 support in Arabic and English (vendor claims).
Admin guide: Moodle integration is an LTI 1.0/1.1 external tool with institution-specific key and secret.
App Store (EG): 'PraxiLabs Player' released 19 Oct 2026 alongside the existing app; both list English only as app language.
athar_applications: Resolves G25 'PraxiLabs Arabic/LTI': LTI 1.1 confirmed; Arabic claimed at platform/support level, but in-simulation Arabic is not evidenced (apps English-only). The forensic-lab-inside-a-case niche is still open.
ATHAR's school integration should support LTI 1.3 to exceed incumbent's LTI 1.1.
limitations: Marketing claims; no product trial; home page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch.
Arabic inside individual simulations not tested.

title: Bad News — Arabic edition ('books/arabic') on getbadnews.com
key_findings: The official site's language menu lists 'العربية' (abbreviation ar) among 29 versions; the Arabic edition page (post dated 29 Jun 2022, modified 15 May 2023) contains the full game script in Arabic (e.g., the player is told the goal is to become an expert in disinformation and fake news).
This corrects ATH-SRC-1136, which recorded that the language list on inoculation.science did not include Arabic.
Efficacy research for Bad News is cataloged elsewhere (ATH-SRC-0520, 0521, 0811) with critical reanalysis (ATH-SRC-0523).
athar_applications: Answers G25 'Is there an Arabic inoculation/prebunking game?': yes, an Arabic translation of Bad News exists (free, web). ATHAR is not first in Arabic prebunking; its source-verification season must add case narrative and measured reasoning, or partner/link instead of rebuilding.
Bad News text is copyrighted: link only.
limitations: No evidence of Arabic-specific validation studies or regional adaptation (examples are translated, not localised).
Usage numbers for the Arabic version unknown.

title: Be Internet Awesome / Interland (Google) — Arabic edition (ar_ALL)
title_ar: أبطال الإنترنت / لعبة عالم الإنترنت (Interland) — النسخة العربية
key_findings: Arabic programme site ('أبطال الإنترنت') and Arabic Interland game are live (html lang ar), including the 'نهر الحقيقة' (Reality River) level on not falling for tricks and fake content.
Wave-1 global CSV listed Interland's Arabic support as 'unknown' (GC-027); now resolved as available.
athar_applications: Free, Google-backed Arabic digital-literacy game already reaches Arab schools' younger grades; ATHAR's misinformation cases should target 13+ with deeper source reasoning and cite Interland as a prerequisite or complement.
Potential partner channel through Google education programmes.
limitations: Aimed at younger children (about 8–12); no outcome data for Arabic users.

title: Ta3limy - تعليمي (Vodafone Egypt) — App Store listing
key_findings: Released 4 May 2023; updated 24 Sep 2026; 4+; Arabic and English; EG App Store 4.8 from 9 ratings.
Relaunch pitch: personalised learning by age, location and goals with hubs for School Education, Career Skills and Entrepreneurship.
athar_applications: Resolves G25 'Vodafone Egypt kids/edutainment': the telco channel is Ta3limy (a learning hub), not a games platform; a possible distribution partner for an Egyptian school pilot of ATHAR content.
Low iOS rating count suggests Android or web dominates its reach (not verified).
limitations: User numbers not published in the listing; Android installs not checked.

title: Zain partners with Sesame Workshop to offer educational content to its Zain Kids digital platform (Kuwait Times)
title_ar: زين تتعاون مع سمسم لتوفير محتوى تعليمي على منصة «زين كيدز»
key_findings: 12 Jun 2022: Zain Group's digital arm Dizlee brought Sesame Workshop's Arabic early-learning programme Ahlan Simsim to the 'Zain Kids' platform.
Markets named: Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Jordan, Bahrain, plus Omantel customers; Digital Virgo provided integration.
athar_applications: Zain has a carrier-billed kids content platform with a precedent of licensing Arabic educational IP: a plausible distribution route for an ATHAR teen tier, though its focus is early childhood.
limitations: 2022 article; current status of Zain Kids not verified in 2026.

title: شرطة دبي تطلق دورة «المتحري الواعد» للارتقاء بالوعي الأمني (Al Bayan)
title_ar: شرطة دبي تطلق دورة «المتحري الواعد» للارتقاء بالوعي الأمني
key_findings: 16 Jul 2026: Dubai Police launched a four-day 'Promising Investigator' (المتحري الواعد) course for students aged 11–14, run by the General Department of Criminal Investigation with the anti-narcotics department, within the police summer student programme.
Partners named: Ministry of Education and KHDA Dubai; content: security and awareness workshops and lectures plus supervised field activities, presented 'in a manner suited to the age group'.
athar_applications: Official appetite in the UAE for young-investigator education with police endorsement: a partnership channel (and credibility signal) for ATHAR's 13–15 cases.
Also a competitor for summer-programme time; ATHAR can offer a digital follow-up for course graduates.
limitations: Press release level; participant numbers for this course not given.
Police framing (security awareness) differs from ATHAR's reasoning focus.

title: Judge SIM 2: Precedent (SunsixStudios) — Steam store page
key_findings: Released 31 Aug 2026; SAR 28.49; Arabic among supported languages; predecessor Judge SIM (3 Apr 2026, SAR 20.99) also supports Arabic.

Player is a judge who rules on objections and decides 'based only on what has been properly established'; opening material consumes a limited margin; rulings become precedents that change later cases.
athar_applications: Arabic-localised 'judge' simulations exist: ATHAR's planned courtroom/argument mode competes with them; the established-facts-only rule mirrors ATHAR's evidence-sufficiency teaching.
Limited-budget evidence opening is a mechanic for teaching information costs.
limitations: Review counts and Arabic quality not checked.

title: Mind Gazing (Tasslehoffus) — Steam store page
key_findings: Released 16 Sep 2026; SAR 15.49; Arabic among supported languages.
One player reads a cryptic scenario; others solve with yes/no questions; 100+ handcrafted scenarios with child-friendly filter; AI solo practice with a 'thought map'.
athar_applications: 'Thought map' of questions asked is an assessable trace of hypothesis testing; ATHAR could visualise a player's question tree after interrogations.
limitations: Party game; marginal overlap; Indonesian rating 18 recorded in Steam metadata.

title: e& UAE launches Kids SIM Card and Parental Control Service (e& press release)
title_ar: إي آند الإمارات تطلق شريحة الأطفال وخدمة الرقابة الأبوية
key_findings: 4 Dec 2024: e& UAE launched a Kids SIM card (two plans, free data for educational content, parent-defined callable numbers) and a Parental Control Service, announced at the WeProtect Global Summit hosted by the UAE Ministry of Interior.

No dedicated e& kids edutainment or games platform was found in this re-check; the telco's 2026 child offer is connectivity plus safety controls (a 2010 'edutainment services' deal with Rubicon is historical).
athar_applications: Resolves G25 'e& kids platform': the entry point is zero-rated educational data and parental controls; ATHAR could seek zero-rating as educational content under the Kids SIM rather than a content-platform deal.
Parent-control positioning by a national telco reinforces ATHAR's dialogue-not-surveillance parent tools must interoperate with operator controls.
limitations: Press release; uptake not disclosed; whitelist criteria for educational content not published.

title: ColdTrace: Cold Case Mystery — Google Play listing (gl=EG and gl=SA, package com.saclicstudio.coldcase)
key_findings: ColdTrace is also on Google Play (Android): install band 1M+ (lifetime, global), 4.6 from 19,260 ratings, rated 'Rated for 3+' (IARC Generic) on the EG page; v1.3.5 updated 26 Oct 2026; listing data also carries the date 27 Jun 2026 (probably the Play release; not labelled on the page); free with ads and in-app items (EGP 92.99–2,099.99 per item on the EG page).

The SA Arabic-locale page renders the short description in Arabic and shows 4.7 stars from the same 19,260 global ratings; the Play page does not list interface languages, so Arabic support on Android is inferred from the iOS listing (ATH-SRC-2065), not confirmed in-app.

This corrects the wave-2 picture that the largest Arabic-supporting 2026 detective launch was visible only through ~275 iOS ratings in three Arab storefronts (ATH-SRC-2065): on Android it is two orders of magnitude larger than any Arabic-made mystery app (best: 1K+ installs, ATH-SRC-2060).
athar_applications: Treat global phone-evidence mysteries with Arabic menus on Android as the top attention threat in Egypt, Morocco, Iraq and Jordan, where Android dominates (ATH-SRC-1945).
Benchmark ATHAR's phone-evidence UI and chapter pacing against ColdTrace; differentiate on teen-reviewed content, reasoning feedback and school use, not on format.
limitations: Install bands are global lifetime and coarse; no per-country installs on Play; Arabic share of users unknown.
A July 2026 Play review asked the developer to add Arabic; whether the Arabic localisation shipped on Android after that was not tested in-app.
Developer name differs across stores (Saclic Studio on iOS; 'Quiet Games.' with a France address on Play).
Fetched with curl (descriptive User-Agent) on 2026-10-27; page SHA-256 (EG, hl=en) 722f76b7…e6ae4683, (SA, hl=ar) 73ce2e21…ae2b3e93; raw pages not stored in the library.
